{{Quote|The ''Mando'ade'' struck the Iskalloni just before your Sith War, freeing many slaves&mdash;including the boy Wyrick. We all make mistakes.|[[Rohlan Dyre]]|<ref name="KotOR48">[[Knights of the Old Republic 48|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 48]]</ref>}}
Shortly prior to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] '''raided the [[Iskalloni|cyborg slavers]] of [[Iskadrell]]'''. Many slaves of the Iskalloni, including a young [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] boy named [[Demagol|Antos Wyrick]], were freed by the Mandalorians and given the chance to join them.
